'''Rahser Poth''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] living during the [[war against Zakuul]]. Following the death of the [[Eternal Empire]] Empress [[Vaylin]] and the formation of the [[Eternal Alliance]] in [[3630 BBY]], he joined Doctor [[Alirra Semhess]]' group of rogue Republic scientists to work on a secret project on the [[X7-Cratus]] space station. Falsely obtaining funding from a Republic endowment for disease research and treatment development, the group instead worked on developing experimental adrenals. Rahser Poth received encrypted communications from an anonymous scientist that allowed him to develop [[RAK-5 serum]], which in turn was refined into [[RS-33]] adrenal.<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Alliance Intelligence Report: RS-33 Adrenal}}</ref> The adrenal greatly enhanced subject's strength and agility at the expense of metal faculties, but in truth both RAK-5 and RS-33 were derived from the [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|Rakghoul plague]], which put them into highly unstable state.<ref name="SWTOR" />

Eternal Alliance operatives under [[Theron Shan]] eventually discovered the project and a strike team was dispatched to X7-Cratus to stop RS-33 from becoming a galactic threat. During the fighting Alliance forces located Poth and killed him. After dispatching Alirra Semhess, the Eternal Alliance secured the station and put an end to the project.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rahser Poth appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' during the "Trial and Error" Uprising.
